items.title: Global poset of cobounded hyperbolic structures on Brown–Higman–Thompson groups

items.work: Hyperbolic actions of Thompson’s group F and generalizations

items.difficulty_reason: H2 is supported by the retained character-elimination core in Propositions4.1–4.3, not by venue or terminology. After the cited confining/action correspondence, the authors still construct a sharp disjoint-bump splitting of F_n, use bounded generation by disjoint fixators to eliminate multi-coordinate characters, build two endpoint-crossing elements in an arbitrary confining subset, and handle three support-position cases to obtain the uniform Q^7 bound for interior characters; endpoint sign cases require a separate Q^3 argument. This is then combined with the retained join construction and character-kernel order comparison to obtain the full global poset. These nonroutine dynamical/algebraic constructions are included, not assumed as external prerequisites.
